items.what: Passport-size picture for an FPSC online application (General Recruitment)
items.other_requirements: jpg/jpeg only; recent passport-size picture; avoid informal pictures

source.name: FPSC Guidelines for Online Application Submission (updated 09-09-2025) (fpsc.gov.pk)
source.quote: Upload softcopy of your passport size picture using ‘Choose File’ button. The picture size must be less than 30 KB and in “jpeg” format only.

items.what: Photograph for the GATE 2027 online application (GOAPS)
items.other_requirements: JPEG/JPG; colour, passport size 3.5 × 4.5 cm, white background; aspect ratio 0.66–0.89; 200 × 260 px min to 530 × 690 px max. (The GATE 2027 photograph web page lists a 5 KB minimum.)

source.name: GATE 2027 Information Brochure, revised 17 October 2026 (gate2027ib.iitm.ac.in)
source.quote: The maximum pixel resolution is 530 × 690 pixels and the minimum resolution is 200 × 260 pixels. The maximum file size that can be uploaded is 600 kB.

items.what: Signature for the GATE 2027 online application (GOAPS)
items.other_requirements: JPEG/JPG; black or dark blue ink; aspect ratio 1:2.75–1:3.75; 250 × 80 px min to 580 × 180 px max

source.name: GATE 2027 Information Brochure, revised 17 October 2026 (gate2027ib.iitm.ac.in)
source.quote: The maximum file size that can be uploaded is 300 kB. The maximum pixel resolution is 580 × 180 pixels and the minimum resolution is 250 × 80 pixels.

items.what: Photo uploaded via ICA e-Services
items.other_requirements: jpg, jpeg, heic, heif or png; dimension 400 × 514 pixels for e-Services uploads

source.name: ICA Singapore: Photo Guidelines
source.quote: jpg, jpeg, heic, heif and png file extension 8MB

items.what: Scanned signature for an APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) application
items.other_requirements: JPEG (.jpg); preferred 250 × 220 pixels

source.name: ICA Singapore: APEC Business Travel Card
source.quote: Scanned signature image file:- in JPEG format ('jpg' extension) - Preferred dimension of 250 x 220 pixels - File size of less than 60 KBytes

items.what: Digital photograph submitted online or via the ImmD mobile app for a passport application
items.other_requirements: JPEG; scanner capture at 600 dpi for a 40 mm × 50 mm photo (camera capture at least 1200 × 1600 px per ImmD)

source.name: Hong Kong ImmD: Photograph Requirements for Travel Document
source.quote: Image type: JPEG File size: 5MB or below

items.organization: Embassy of India, Bogotá (Passport Seva applicant portal)
items.what: Supporting documents uploaded with an Indian passport application at the embassy (applicant portal)
items.other_requirements: Maximum 1 MB, and all uploaded documents together no more than 1 MB. Same guideline gives photo dimensions 630 × 810 px, colour, white background (no photo KB limit stated). Issued by one mission; other Indian missions may publish their own

source.name: Embassy of India Bogotá: Guidelines for uploading of ICAO photograph, signature and documents (PDF)
source.quote: Maximum Size allowed 1 MB  The total of all uploaded documents should be not more than 1 MB

items.organization: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Estonia (State Protocol Department)
items.what: Digital document photo for an Estonian diplomatic ID card application
items.other_requirements: Colour, unedited; 40 × 50 mm; at least 1300 × 1600 px; taken in last six months; a minimum, not just a maximum, applies. Document dated 2025-11

source.name: Estonian MFA: Requirements for a photo (PDF, vm.ee, 2025-11)
source.quote: The file size of the document photo must be at least 1 MB and a maximum of 5 MB
